g.text: True sunshine helps by about 1 point; the ENS forecast of it does not

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each row is the first arm's quantile score minus the second's, over the scored rows. Dot: estimate. Line: interval from re-drawing whole months of run initialisation and seeds (solid: 97.5%, Bonferroni across the two deciding contrasts; dashed: 95%, exploratory). Left rule at -0.35: the smallest gain worth porting. Right rule at 0: same score. Five Primary substations, daylight half- hours of April to September, 73 forecast runs one every 5 days: July to September 2025 and April to June 2026.'
